name: Pruébate: virtual try-on with AI
author: Nelson Daniel Argañaraz

sections.description:
Pruébate adds a virtual try-on to the product page of every garment in your WooCommerce store. The customer uploads a full-body photo and sees the garment on them (an AI simulation, not an exact fit). Try-ons come out of the quota of your Pruébate account, and you decide how many each customer gets.

Features

  • “Try it on with your photo” button under the add-to-cart form.
  • “What size fits me?” button, using the real flat measurements of each garment that you load in Pruébate. It does not spend try-ons.
  • Works for visitors without an account; the limits per customer, per day and per garment are set in your Pruébate panel.
  • Available in English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese (the try-on windows are in Spanish or Portuguese, following your site language).

Requirements

  • A free Pruébate account: the plugin creates it for you with the “Connect with Pruébate” button (10 try-ons to evaluate).
  • Your site must use https.

External service. This plugin relies on the third-party service Pruébate (https://pruebate.com.ar), operated by the plugin author, to generate the try-on and the size recommendation. What is sent and when:

  • When you press “Connect with Pruébate” in Settings: your site address is sent to Pruébate, which sends you back to your Settings page with the store key.
  • When a product page with a button is opened: the product number, your store key (pk_…) and your site address, to check that the button can be shown. If the visitor is logged in, their WordPress user number is sent too, to apply the per-customer limits.
  • When the customer taps a button and uses it: the photo they choose (only for the try-on), and for the size recommendation, body measurements estimated on their own device.
  • Pruébate then reads the product (name, categories, main image) from your public WooCommerce Store API (/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products) to know what to show. If you press “Bring my products” in your Pruébate panel, it reads your public catalog the same way, to let you load garment measurements.
  • The photo is used only for that try-on and is deleted when it finishes. The AI provider deletes its copy within 24 hours.

Terms and privacy policy: https://pruebate.com.ar/privacidad
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce is required).
  2. Go to Settings → Pruébate and press “Connect with Pruébate”. Create your free account (or sign in) and confirm your site address: you come back to WordPress with the key already saved.
  3. Open any product page: the button appears once the garment can be tried on.

If you already have a key (it starts with pk_), you can paste it in Settings → Pruébate instead. You can also create it at https://pruebate.com.ar/woocommerce/conectar.

Step-by-step guide (in Spanish), from installing to loading measurements and buying try-ons: https://pruebate.com.ar/manual-woocommerce
sections.faq:
Does it cost anything?

Signing up is free and includes 10 try-ons to evaluate. Beyond that, you buy try-on packs in your Pruébate panel. The plugin itself is free.

Does it change my checkout, products or orders?

No. The plugin only draws the buttons on the product page. Your catalog, prices, stock and orders stay in WooCommerce.

Which products can be tried?

Clothes. Accessories and footwear are not tried on. The category is decided from the name and categories of the product.

How do I turn on “What size fits me?”

In your Pruébate panel press “Bring my products” and load the flat measurements of each garment. The button appears on the garments that have measurements.

What happens to my customers’ photos?

They are used only to generate the try-on and deleted at the end. See the privacy policy: https://pruebate.com.ar/privacidad
